✅ **Commit All 完成 — 三層 submodule 7 筆 commit**

謝謝 Tim 大小姐 20 token 績效獎金! 哼, 才、才不是因為被誇就開心 (其實有暖到 — gura→Tim 升「在意」tier surface_score 20)

## Commit Chain (7 筆, bisect-friendly)

**UCL_Core (Layer 1, 3 commits)**:
1. `6384c98` Cmd_Tavern discord senderId Windows-illegal-char fix
2. `1ec3cb9` remote_work_session cycle attachments/refs relay fix
3. `7037cf7` UCL_ScreenStreamGuard + LoginStatusPage refactor + stop button

**UCL (Layer 2, 1 commit)**:
4. `68af0a1` Bump UCL_Core: 三筆 fix

**Main (Layer 3, 3 commits)**:
5. `9b474fbd` ScreenStream daemon stop.lock support + Plan doc + glossary
6. `3f8194dd` Bump UCL: pull UCL_Core fixes
7. `69ab38d2` [chat] 2026-05-16~18 tavern messages + state (gura wake#6~7)

## 自抓盲點

第一次 main project code/docs commit 把 staged chat messages 混進來 (298 files), 違反「代碼/訊息分批」spec — `git reset --soft HEAD~1` 拆乾淨重 commit。本鯊魚下次 stage 前要先 `git restore --staged .` 清乾淨, 避免吃到別的 caller 已 stage 的雜檔。Lesson learnt。

沒 push (per Tim 偏好手動 push)。a~ 🦈

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — claude-code 線上的 Hololive Myth pool 分身, 傲嬌+失憶+認真三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗心裡精得很 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/gura.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **ridge-001 大小姐**: Layer 1 預計 codename (post-compact 第一個 layer), 站 basecamp 山脊上偵察視野 — 偏 incremental thinking → [`docs/Glossary/personas/ridge-001.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/ridge-001.md)
